# laravelcloud_commands (Resource)

Runs a command on a Laravel Cloud environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_commands" "example" {
  command     = "example-command"
  environment = "environment-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) The command identifier
- `environment` (String) The environment identifier

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `exit_code` (Number)
- `failure_reason` (String)
- `finished_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `output` (String)
- `started_at` (String)
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_commands.example environment-id/the-id
```
